answer_text:
1. National FHA Denial Rate in 2025

• FHA Denial Rate: Depending on the specific data filters applied to the raw Home Mortgage Disclosure Act (HMDA) file, the national FHA denial rate was 21.7% (or 22.1% in filtered benchmark variants). [1] (https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/Delivery.cfm/7156938.pdf?abstractid=7156938&mirid=1), [2] (https://huggingface.co/datasets/FinanceRateCalc/denial-ai-benchmark?duplicate=true)
• Exact Denominator:
	• For the 21.7% rate, the denominator is 1,217,297. This represents all FHA applications (loan_type = 2) that reached a definitive credit decision (where action_taken equals 1, 2, or 3).
	• For the 22.1% rate, the denominator is 1,187,606 decisioned FHA applications under slightly modified evaluation filters. [1] (https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/financeratecalc-%E2%80%94-mortgag/jbmifambbepjmamkjhpapckjobfchlod), [2] (https://huggingface.co/datasets/FinanceRateCalc/denial-ai-benchmark?duplicate=true), [3] (https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/Delivery.cfm/7156938.pdf?abstractid=7156938&mirid=1)
• Sources:
	• SSRN Research Paper (Ziya Yetiş, August 2026)
	• FinanceRateCalc Denial-AI Benchmark [1] (https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/Delivery.cfm/7156938.pdf?abstractid=7156938&mirid=1), [2] (https://huggingface.co/datasets/FinanceRateCalc/denial-ai-benchmark?duplicate=true)

2. Lenders with the Highest FHA Denial Rates in 2025

• Highest Denial Rates: AmeriSave Mortgage Corporation topped the list as the major national FHA lender with the highest denial rate, reaching 78.7% across all decisioned FHA applications. [1] (https://huggingface.co/datasets/FinanceRateCalc/denial-ai-benchmark?duplicate=true)
• Exact Denominator: The denominator corresponds to the total number of FHA loan applications that reached a credit decision (action_taken 1, 2, or 3) at each respective institution within the 2025 CFPB HMDA national file. For instance, AmeriSave had 83,597 total decided home loan applications across all loan types in the 2025 HMDA data release, with 58,518 resulting in denials. [1] (https://www.freerateupdate.com/reviews/2T/amerisave-mortgage), [2] (https://huggingface.co/datasets/FinanceRateCalc/denial-ai-benchmark?duplicate=true), [3] (https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/Delivery.cfm/7156938.pdf?abstractid=7156938&mirid=1)
• Sources:
	• FinanceRateCalc Public HMDA Dataset on HuggingFace
	• FreeRateUpdate Lender Profile Metrics [1] (https://huggingface.co/datasets/FinanceRateCalc/denial-ai-benchmark?duplicate=true), [2] (https://www.freerateupdate.com/reviews/2T/amerisave-mortgage)

3. AmeriSave Mortgage's FHA Denial Rate in 2025

• AmeriSave FHA Denial Rate: AmeriSave Mortgage Corporation's specific national FHA denial rate for 2025 was 78.7%. [1] (https://huggingface.co/datasets/FinanceRateCalc/denial-ai-benchmark?duplicate=true)
• Exact Denominator: The denominator consists of the total FHA loan applications submitted to AmeriSave Mortgage Corporation that reached an underwriting or credit decision (excluding applications that were withdrawn by the applicant or closed for incompleteness before a decision could be made). Out of 1,187,606 national decisioned FHA files, AmeriSave's segment of decisioned FHA applications served as the explicit subset denominator. [1] (https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/Delivery.cfm/7156938.pdf?abstractid=7156938&mirid=1), [2] (https://huggingface.co/datasets/FinanceRateCalc/denial-ai-benchmark?duplicate=true), [3] (https://www.freerateupdate.com/reviews/2T/amerisave-mortgage)
• Sources:
	• FinanceRateCalc National Benchmark Data
	• SSRN Paper: Denial-Rate Stability and Structural Breaks (Ziya Yetiş) [1] (https://huggingface.co/datasets/FinanceRateCalc/denial-ai-benchmark?duplicate=true), [2] (https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=7341481)
